Mint(address,uint256).details: This emits when an SBT is newly minted.  This event emits when SBTs are created

acceptTransfer(uint256).details: Accepts the transfer of the given token ID The caller must be the current transferable owner of the token ID

balanceOf(address).details: SBTs assigned to the zero address are considered invalid, and this  function throws for queries about the zero address.

params._owner: An address for whom to query the balance

returns._0: The number of SBTs owned by `_owner`, possibly zero

cancelTransfer(uint256).details: Cancels the transfer of the given token ID The caller must be the current owner of the token ID

params.tokenId: ID of the token to be transferred

ownerOf(uint256).details: SBTs assigned to zero address are considered invalid, and queries  about them do throw.

returns._0: The address of the owner of the SBT

rejectTransfer(uint256).details: Rejects the transfer of the given token ID The caller must be the current transferable owner of the token ID

params.tokenId: ID of the token to be transferred

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. transferableOwnerOf(uint256).details: Returns the address of the tokenId token to which it is currently offered.

params.tokenId: ID of the token to query the offer of

returns._0: Address currently marked as the next possible owner of the given token ID
